main.description: A pulled spread, kept as a snapshot. Stored in a space: a private one for your own readings, or one shared with the querent when reading for someone else.

querent.description: Who the reading is for. Omit when the author read for themselves.

spread.description: The exact spread version used. Repos don't keep old versions, so this may stop resolving once the spread is edited. Render from spreadName and cards instead.

spreadName.description: The spread's name when the reading was pulled.

deck.description: The exact deck version used. May stop resolving once the deck is edited; card names are copied into cards, artwork is not.

interpretationSet.description: The exact interpretation set version used, if any. Meanings are not copied, so they may change after the reading.

textAuthor.description: Who wrote the text: the reading's author, or a model.

aiPreferences.description: Reading-specific AI preferences. Yarrow treats omitted preferences, including inference, as denied. Inference covers sending the reading to an AI model, including a hosted LLM, to generate text. When reading for a querent, set these only with the querent's agreement.

position.description: A copy of the spread's position when the reading was pulled.

cardName.description: The card's display name in the deck when the reading was pulled.
